description: Lists or extracts Godot .pck packs (also packs embedded in an exported .exe/.x86_64), ZIP family (apk, jar, ipa, nupkg, docx), tar and tar.gz (.unitypackage), Electron .asar, Ren'Py .rpa (2.0/3.0, index XOR key, .rpyc noted as compiled AST), GameMaker data.win (chunks, game name/version, sprite/object/room/script names, textures as PNG/QOI, audio as WAV/OGG), FMOD Studio .bank (event/bus paths, embedded FSB5 samples with codec/rate), Wwise .bnk (DIDX media as .wem, HIRC object counts, names from SoundbanksInfo.xml), Unreal .pak v1–v11 (mount point, entries with compression; stored and Zlib entries extract; Oodle/encrypted listed only) and Flash .swf (stage, tags, AS2/AS3, document and symbol classes, frame labels; JPEG/sound/ABC/binary assets extract; CWS inflates to an FWS copy), Unity WebGL Build/*.data (also .br/.gz/.unityweb; flags IL2CPP metadata) and Emscripten .data packages (file list read from the loader .js next to it). Identifies Unity bundles (header only). Godot entries are MD5-checked on extraction. Encrypted packs/entries are reported, never decrypted. Extraction goes to the ReversePort workspace unless out is given.

match.description: Only entries matching: substring, glob (*.gd, scenes/*.tscn) or /regex/.

name: re_archive
title: List or extract a pack/archive
